title: Final Evaluation Results of the Research Assistant Applications Published in the Official Gazette No. 32765, Dated 27.12.2024 (Cyber Security Engineering)
bodyHtml:
Within the scope of the Priority Area, to access the Final Evaluation Form for the Research Assistant position in the Department of Cyber Security Engineering, Cyber Security Engineering Division, published in the Official Gazette No. 32765, dated 27.12.2024, click here.

The candidate who has successfully passed the exam must personally apply to our Faculty's Personnel Office with a petition by the end of working hours on February 11, 2025. The required documents include:

  • A health report (it is not mandatory to obtain it from a fully equipped hospital; a document proving the candidate is fit to work is sufficient),
  • A residence certificate (from e-Government),
  • 2 photographs (taken within the last 6 months).

No additional notification will be made.

If the primary candidate does not apply within the given time frame, the application period for the alternate candidate will be announced on our website on February 12, 2025. No additional notification will be made.

title: Submit Your Research to the New D3AI Journal
bodyHtml:
The International Journal of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Applications (D3AI), published by IU Press and expected to be indexed in reputable databases soon, is now accepting leading academic articles in computer and information technologies for its inaugural issue, scheduled for release in January. Articles published in this journal may contribute points under the "Articles Published in Other Peer-Reviewed Journals" category, according to updated associate professorship criteria.


For details, you can visit our journal's website.

title: Entertech Academy 'Bootcamp Program' Begins!
bodyHtml:
Entertech Academy 'Bootcamp Program' Begins!


Would you like to take part in the software team of our companies within Entertech Istanbul Teknokent, which operates in many fields from informatics to health, from finance to software?

If you want to take your place among the software developers of the future, apply now, successfully complete the free training, get your certificate and have the opportunity to be employed as a Junior Back-End Developer, Junior Front-End Developer or Junior Data Scientist!


Trainings;

 Back-End with C# and .NET Core

 Front-End with ReactJS

 Data Science and Machine Learning with Python


Who can participate?

• If you are a 3rd or 4th year university student, or a recent graduate

• You are open to innovations, a fast learner, and prone to teamwork.

• If you are willing to work in companies within Entertech Istanbul Teknokent

• You are responsible, take initiative and have a high desire to improve.


Entertech Academy is just for you!

Application Deadline: 9 November 2023


For detailed information and application:

http://www.entertech.com.tr/

title: Open Academic Collaboration Call
bodyHtml:
For the Department of Computer Engineering, we invite academics interested in joint project development, collaboration, and academic activities. Priority will be given to those whose bachelor’s or doctoral degree is in Computer Engineering and who are proficient in teaching in English. Interested academics may contact us via the faculty e-mail ([kaldırıldı]).

Our R&D coordinator is Dr. Lecturer Member Abbas Memiş. Please direct your collaboration proposals, project ideas, and academic activity inquiries to him directly.
